snippet.title: FLAMECRAFT - Official Early Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://bit.ly/4iRkxlS
New Developer Update NOW LIVE! Check it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3201730/view/807960799362417267?l=english

Flamecraft is a cozy, turn-based strategy board game for 1 to 5 players. Become a Flamekeeper and help artisan dragons and shopkeepers delight the townspeople with their craft. Gather and manage resources, enhance the shops by casting enchantments, and magic your way to becoming the best Flamekeeper.

Sign up to our newsletter on the official website: https://monstercouch.com/flamecraft
Official Discord: https://discord.gg/QyV2yKjnjJ
